pairs: Domine, quoniam ego in innocentia mea ingressus sum,
Lord, for I have been walking in my innocence,
et in Domino sperans non infirmabor.
and by hoping in the Lord, I will not be weakened.
ure renes meos et cor meum.
enkindle my temperament and my heart.
Quoniam misericordia tua ante oculos meos est,
For your mercy is before my eyes,
and I am serene in your truth.
I have not sat with the council of emptiness,
et cum iniqua gerentibus non introibo.
and I will not enter with those who carry out injustice.
I have hated the assembly of the malicious;
and I will not sit with the impious.
I will wash my hands among the innocent,
and I will surround your altar,
so that I may hear the voice of your praise
I have loved the beauty of your house
and the dwelling place of your glory.
Ne perdas cum impiis, Deus, animam meam, et cum viris sanguinum vitam meam:
O God, do not let my soul perish with the impious, nor my life with the men of blood,
their right hand has been filled by bribes.
Ego autem in innocentia mea ingressus sum;
But as for me, I have been walking in my innocence.
My foot has stood firm in the straight path.
In the churches, I will bless you,
